invariants.rationale: Either the method returned early because element is null, or we processed only when the name is 'properties'.
If element is null, the method returns early; otherwise, properties is used and must not be null.
If element is not null and processed, getChildrenByName('property') must not be null for iteration.
If element is not null, and has a name, it must be 'properties', else the body does nothing.
